quotes.quote: Total 101 lesions were included. Forty-three lesions were treated with cryotherapy and 58 lesions were assigned as control.
At the fourth month, dermatologists' assessment revealed that 82.3% of the treated lesions comparing to only 2% of the control showed more than 75% improvement (p < .001).
A single session of tip cryotherapy was delivered and remained for 5 s.
Total 101 lesions were included. Forty-three lesions were treated with cryotherapy and 58 lesions were assigned as control.
At the fourth month, dermatologists' assessment revealed that 82.3% of the treated lesions comparing to only 2% of the control showed more than 75% improvement (p < .001).
Total 101 lesions were included. Forty-three lesions were treated with cryotherapy and 58 lesions were assigned as control.
the score of the treated lesions has been significantly lower than that of the control lesions since week 8 (p = .005).
Colorimeter was used to measure lesional luminosity at baseline and then monthly until 4 months.
Burning sensation was the most common side effect.

verifier.notes: row 0, time_from_last_treatment: source gives time from baseline only ('at baseline and then monthly until 4 months'; 'At the fourth month') and never says when the single session was given, so CLAUDE.md rule 2 requires NOT_DERIVABLE, not an assumed [4 months]; row 0, months_after_final_tx: '4' is unbracketed and not derivable from the source for the same reason; should be NOT_DERIVABLE; row 2, time_from_last_treatment: same as row 0; source counts from baseline only; row 2, months_after_final_tx: same as row 0; '4' not derivable; row 2, endpoint_definition: source does not state that lower luminosity means less white; it says only 'Mean luminosity scale gradually decreased from baseline' and treated scores were 'significantly lower'. The direction is an inference and must be in [square brackets] (rule 9)
